title: Tiny, cute train
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tracks -->
  <rect x="10" y="82" width="80" height="6" rx="3" fill="#5a4a42"/>
  <rect x="10" y="80" width="80" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#8c7a70"/>

  <rect x="68" y="86" width="4" height="4" rx="1" fill="#b8a89a"/>

  <!-- Train body -->
  <rect x="18" y="50" width="64" height="30" rx="8" fill="#e8463c"/>
  <rect x="18" y="50" width="64" height="8" rx="4" fill="#ff6b5e"/>

  <!-- Cab -->
  <rect x="52" y="30" width="30" height="26" rx="6" fill="#d63a30"/>

  <!-- Smoke puffs -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="24" r="5" fill="#c8d8e8"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="18" r="4" fill="#b0c4d8"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="13" r="3" fill="#98b0c8"/>

  <!-- Front bumper / face -->
  <rect x="14" y="56" width="8" height="18" rx="4" fill="#ffb020"/>
  <circle cx="18" cy="62" r="3" fill="#ffe070"/>
  <circle cx="18" cy="70" r="2.5" fill="#ffe070"/>

  <circle cx="30" cy="82" r="9" fill="#3a3a4a"/>

  <circle cx="30" cy="82" r="2" fill="#ffd040"/>

  <circle cx="50" cy="82" r="9" fill="#3a3a4a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="82" r="5" fill="#8a8a9a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="82" r="2" fill="#ffd040"/>

  <circle cx="70" cy="82" r="9" fill="#3a3a4a"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="82" r="5" fill="#8a8a9a"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="82" r="2" fill="#ffd040"/>

  <!-- Window on body -->
  <rect x="26" y="56" width="14" height="12" rx="3" fill="#3a2a2a"/>
  <rect x="28" y="57" width="10" height="10" rx="2" fill="#7ee8ff"/>
  <rect x="28" y="57" width="10" height="4" rx="2" fill="#c8f8ff"/>

  <rect x="44" y="62" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#ffb020"/>
